create_Trajectory_from_proto: create a Trajectory object from a mocap proto with optional start and end time slicing
call_as_dict: call as_dict on a Trajectory to get all walker and prop pose data as numpy arrays
call_get_modified_trajectory: call get_modified_trajectory on a Trajectory to apply proto modifiers and return a new Trajectory
call_set_walker_poses: call set_walker_poses on a Trajectory to apply mocap poses to walkers in a physics environment
call_configure_walkers: call configure_walkers on a Trajectory to rescale walkers and add marker sites from mocap data
